audience: field-service businesses such as HVAC and plumbing firms who run jobs and technicians in Service Fusion

useCases.title: See which jobs are scheduled and who is assigned
useCases.text: The AI lists jobs filtered by status, customer or dates, opens one with its technicians and visits, and lists calendar tasks for a day.

useCases.title: Find an open technician slot
useCases.text: The AI reads open time slots for technicians or crews over up to 8 days, filtered by technician, crew or department.

useCases.title: Check which invoices are unpaid
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices with number, total, paid flag, dates and customer, sorted by date, and opens single ones.

useCases.title: Review a customer and their equipment
useCases.text: The AI finds a customer by name, phone, email or address, reads contacts and locations, and lists the equipment on file with make, model and warranty dates.

useCases.title: Review estimates you sent
useCases.text: The AI lists estimates (quotes) by status, customer or dates and opens one with its line items.

useCases.title: Create a customer, job or estimate
useCases.text: The AI creates a customer with contacts and service locations, a job (work order) or an estimate, using your job categories.
